fusions.name: Flush from Cover
fusions.desc: Throws a clod that deals 4 damage with a 35% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow, which deals 16 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health, and that threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Sunk Hide
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds in a hide dug into the ground. Enemies notice you far later and you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Stopped Earths
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
